page.notes:
Brace labels in the right margin, top to bottom: Italiae; Delphinatus; Lugd. Tract.; Franciae; Campaniae; Burgundiae Ducatus; Picardiae.

A vertical note between the two columns reads: "Omnia his locis valde sunt confusa."

The right edge of the page is cut off, so the ends of the opening and closing lines are incomplete. Some distance figures in the Antonini column are doubtful.

Marginal numbers 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 sit beside the list lines. The left edge of the page is cut off, so some words at line starts are incomplete. Some words are doubtful in the scan.
